verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Dedicated Model Inference (DMI) for serving models on reserved/isolated hardware distinct from the shared serverless pool, with no hard rate limits, and a dedicated scaling doc showing configurable autoscaling via replica limits, plus deployment of fine-tuned or custom models via CLI. This directly matches the story's requirements of dedicated GPU capacity, autoscaling, and isolation from shared serverless traffic. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of autoscaling behavior in production and concrete GPU-type/SLA details beyond docs.
